description: Quantum inputs for the OpenSci network export. They are user-supplied: the classical Gaussian sources of the Project only define the spatial modes, wavelength and polarization of the network.

photons.note: one single photon per exported source, in that source's V input mode

broadband.note: |psi(t)|^2 Gaussian with this rms width; zero_delay_indistinguishability = |<psi_A|psi_B>|^2 at zero delay (spectral purity and mismatch)

detectors.note: one polarization-insensitive threshold detector per output plane, covering both of its output modes

validity.note: a single-wavelength transfer matrix is used only when the group-delay spread of one photon's paths to one output is at most this fraction of its rms duration
